frames.gloss: 不是……而是……：否定 of 后的内容，主句才是实际发生/被选择的情况。
frames.pattern_notes:
介词性框架，of 后只能接名词或动名词，不能接不定式；可置于句首修饰整个主句，也可在句中作状语。
误读判据强：学习者常误接 to do，或把否定范围读反（以为主句才是被否定的）。
同族变体：句首副词 "Instead, [主句]"（本批 S00159）。

examples.s: Instead of saying “I want to lose three kilos”, I would say “I want to run two kilometres in eight minutes” or “I want to be able to do 30 push-ups”.
Instead of being kept in cages, wildlife can move about freely.
Wang Ming: But what could Yu Gong do instead of moving the mountains?

frames.frame: Could you tell me [wh-/whether + 陈述语序]?
frames.gloss: 能否告诉我……：礼貌请求信息，嵌入问句必须用陈述语序。
frames.pattern_notes:
直接疑问句嵌入 tell me 后倒装取消：where we could go next（而非 where could we go next），是疑问句转嵌套时最稳定的错序点。
与已有框架“疑问词+do you think+陈述语序”难点相同但结构不同：这里是宾语从句嵌套，疑问词留在从句句首。
同族：介词后接 whether（不接 if）的嵌入问句，本批 J04653 “write about whether they think...”。

examples.s: Could you tell me where we could go next?
Could you tell me where I can get something to eat?

frames.gloss: 鉴于、考虑到……：以已知条件为前提推出主句。
frames.pattern_notes:
句首 Given 是介词/连词性凝固用法，后接名词短语或 how/that 从句，不是 give 的被动分词，不找施事。
已有清单的“句首分词状语”指 V-ing 形式；Given+NP 是其词汇化变体，误读判据强：学习者会读成“被给予”。
主句常配 would/情态动词表推断（one would think...）。

examples.s: Given how narrow his legs are and how much he leans to his right, one would think that the statue would break or fall over, yet it still stands more than 500 years later.
Given the fine weather, Australians love to eat

frames.gloss: 未来的、即将到来的：to come 后置修饰前面的时间名词。
frames.pattern_notes:
to come = that is to come / that will come，作时间名词的后置定语：for generations to come（未来世世代代）、in years to come（未来岁月）。
误读判据：学习者易把 to come 当作即将出现的谓语动词而断句失败。
虚词 for/in 与名词槽固定，整存整取查表价值高。

examples.s: With these measures, it is believed that the beauty of the Li River will be preserved for generations to come.
Trading has grown greatly in recent years, and will continue to do so in years to come.

frames.gloss: which 回指前面整句（这件事），而不是某个名词：“这意味着/这将导致……”。
frames.pattern_notes:
已有清单含“非限定性关系从句”，此处报其新变体：先行项是整个前句或刚陈述的事件，如 which means（也就是说）、which will no doubt start...（此事将……）。
误读判据：学习者回找最近名词作先行词会造成语义错位。
逗号必现，which 从句自带完整主谓。

examples.s: People from the UK are called “British”, which means the UK is also often referred to as Britain or Great Britain.
“Barren” is also a new word to me, which means empty.
The famous designer released her new line on Wednesday, which will no doubt start a new fashion trend this year.

frames.frame: [S] be used to [V] / be used for [V-ing/NP]
frames.gloss: 被用来做……：表用途或功能的被动框架。
frames.pattern_notes:
三条形近结构需整存整取：used to [V]（过去惯常，无 be）、be used to [V-ing]（习惯于）、be used to [V]/for [V-ing]（被用来）。
误读判据强：“were used to pay” 会被读成“过去常常支付”。
used 是 use 的过去分词，后接目的不定式或 for+动名词/名词。

examples.s: The profits from the farm were then used to pay for the education of poor children.
Horses, donkeys, mules, and water buffaloes were all used for farm work.
Biofuel projects use up land, which could be used for growing food.

candidates.note: 破折号插入语打断 as...as 比较框架：“as A as —if not more A than— B”。误读判据强，属已有 as...as 框架的插入变体，但本批仅 1 例，不满足≥2。

example.s: This virtual world will at times seem as real as—if not more real than—the actual world around us.

candidates.note: “祈使句 + and + 陈述句”表条件（Do [V] and [result]）：骨架与误读判据均强，仅 1 例。

example.s: Waiter: Put on your glasses and you can see the mutton.

candidates.note: 完全倒装 “Following [NP] were [NP]”：分词/方位词前置触发主谓倒装，正则盲区“补语前置”，仅 1 例。

example.s: Following the reindeer were the Sami people, who made this territory their home.

candidates.note: “as is typical of [NP]” 评论性 as 从句：as+be+表语回指整句，仅 1 例。

example.s: During their first day, as is typical of Vancouver, it rained.

candidates.note: 句首 “As well as [V-ing], [主句]”（除……之外还）：与比较义 as well as 同形异义，误读判据强，仅 1 例。

example.s: “As well as studying hard, I’ve been involved in social activities.

candidates.note: “worth [V-ing]”（值得做）：动名词主动式表被动义，误读判据强；本批另一例 S03562 “was worth it” 原文残缺，凑不满 2 个干净例句。

example.s: Anybody be someone who is worth getting to know.

candidates.note: “to one's surprise”（令某人惊讶的是）：话语标记框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: But to our surprise, he allowed Hussey to keep his banjo.

candidates.note: “as few [N] as possible”：as...as 的“尽可能”变体，仅 1 例自然语篇例。

example.s: The idea behind organic food is that food is grown and processed in ways that use as few chemicals as possible.

candidates.note: “the [ADJ], the [ADJ], and the [ADJ]”（the+形容词名词化列举）：名词化串联盲区，仅 1 例。

example.s: When it comes to wildlife protection, all species—the good, the bad, and the ugly— should be treated equally.

candidates.note: “When asked whether...”：when+V-ed 省略被动状语，是已有“句首分词状语”的省略变体，仅 1 例。

example.s: When asked whether their eating habits are common among their age group, both Mei Lin and Su Bo say they are.

candidates.note: “regret not [V-ing]”（后悔没做）：regret 接动名词且否定词前置，仅 1 例且原文有空缺。

example.s: ” She regrets not bringing a to Ghana to boil the water she needs.

candidates.note: “vary from X to X”（因人而异）：仅 1 例。

example.s: C: This may vary from person to person.

candidates.note: “be referred to as [称呼]（by [来源]）”：与已有 be known/regarded as 同族，仅动词更换，是否算独立新变体拿不准，待更多例句确认。

example.s: The People The nickname Kiwi used to refer to the country of New Zealand, but after the First World War, New Zealanders began to be referred to (and to refer to themselves) by the nickname “Kiwis”.

candidates.note: “疑问词 + to [V]”（how to get there / how to care for animals，另见 J04530）：语法课显性教授，骨架判据偏弱（更像规则而非框架），拿不准。

example.s: Sorry, I'm not sure how to get there.
